method: Dashboard place types derived from NCES 2025 Census-based locales and 2020 Census PL 94-171 voting-age population. Urban = NCES city (11–13); Suburban = suburb (21–23); Exurban = town-fringe (31) or rural-fringe (41); Rural = town-distant/remote (32–33) or rural-distant/remote (42–43). A group or county needs more than 50% of its 2020 age-18+ residents in one geographic type. Rural Anglo additionally requires more than 50% White alone non-Hispanic residents age 18+; Rural Hispanic requires more than 50% Hispanic residents age 18+. Otherwise Other / unclassified, including zero-population areas. Unlocated population stays in the denominator; classify only when a known geographic count still exceeds half of all age-18+ residents. Census blocks are assigned whole by their internal point, following the existing precinct Census method. Place types describe geographic populations, not the ethnicity or party of voters. No election votes are allocated.
geometry_repair_method: GEOS make_valid linework, no snapping or vote allocation
